text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad I was able to buy that nutrition 
management book safely..."

text_block_list.name: Person in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
Oho, management?! Are you interested in 
management? If you'd like, why not join 
our study group—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you. I'm in a bit of a hurry, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Person in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
Don't say that~! I promise it'll be super 
helpful~!

Faced with persistent recruitment, Ikuno 
Dictus found herself growing mentally 
exhausted.
